On 14 March 2023, at 9:45 a.m., the café on Rue Saint-Denis reopened after a 7-month renovation that cost €1.2 million (roughly $1,300,000 at the time).

The owner, Zoë Brontë-Müller, said the work "took longer than anyone expected — about twice as long, honestly." She added: 'We found 3 layers of 1920s tiles under the floor!'

Prices rose by 12.5%, from €3.20 to €3.60 for an espresso; a croissant now costs €2.15. Regulars, e.g. the retired physicist Dr. Ilse Novák, did not seem to mind... much.

Details are posted at https://example.org/news/2023/cafe-reopening-renovation-details.html for anyone curious about the façade, the naïve mural, or the new state-of-the-art coffee-roasting equipment.

Q: Is the terrace open year-round? A: No — only from April to October, weather permitting (and never before 8 o'clock).
